faqs.question: What is the guest Wi-Fi network and password?
faqs.answer: You can connect to network 'AURA-Guest-5G'. The guest passcode is 'Welcome2026!'. Terms of service will prompt on connection.

faqs.question: Where are the restrooms located?
faqs.answer: Restrooms are located on every floor immediately past the elevator lobby on the left hand side. Accessible restrooms are adjacent to Room 102 on this ground floor.

faqs.question: Where can I get coffee or lunch?
faqs.answer: Our complimentary Coffee & Refreshment Lounge is to your right next to the atrium. The main cafeteria 'AURA Garden Bistro' is on the 2nd Floor and serves hot meals from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM.

faqs.question: How do I validate my parking ticket?
faqs.answer: Guest parking validation is fully complimentary! You can tap your parking ticket on the validation scanner right beside this receptionist kiosk before leaving.

faqs.question: What are the standard office operating hours?
faqs.answer: Our headquarters is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Building access outside these hours requires security keycard clearance.

faqs.question: What are the emergency exits and first aid locations?
faqs.answer: Emergency exits are illuminated at both North and South corridors. The primary assembly point is the South Courtyard. A First Aid kit and automated defibrillator (AED) are located directly beside this kiosk.

faqs.question: Where can I find drinking water?
faqs.answer: Chilled filtered water and sparkling water dispensers are available in the visitor waiting lounge, just 10 paces behind you.
